prompt:
I have an old React class component that uses local state and lifecycle methods. I want to understand how to convert it to use hooks instead. The component has a componentDidMount that fetches data and a componentDidUpdate that checks if props have changed. Can you explain the hooks equivalent for these lifecycle methods?

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.
